prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, mid 50s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy jet-black latex catsuit with long sleeves and matching latex gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the latex fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless jet-black latex hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the latex: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders drooping, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Wear: The suit is scuffed grey along her thighs, knees and elbows, dusted with soot and streaked with rust-brown stains from the iron at her wrists and ankles, sweat beads on the polish, and the gloves are blackened on the backs of her hands. Faint soot smudges circle the openings around her eyes, her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy jet-black latex with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy latex hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a tired, faintly beaten look, her gaze dropping and her mouth softening, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
